messages:
Mika (Marketing): Quick sync — we're aiming to launch the Community Hub + OSS reference app the week of Apr 20. Need deliverables: launch blog, 2 tutorials (get-started + integration), 1-hr webinar, benchmark narrative, and inbound lead routing. Who can own which pieces?

Jon (DevRel): I can do the tutorials and live demo for the webinar. Planning 25min demo + 20min Q&A.

Ara (Content): I'll draft the launch blog + benchmark narrative. Need benchmark numbers from Kevin by EOD Tue.

Kevin (Data): Got it. I'll pull token/latency/cost comparisons across our top two models and the dedicated config. Expect CSV + short summary by Tue 6pm.

Sam (PM): For launch sequencing: blog + refapp repo -> tutorial -> webinar. Webinar promo starts 2 weeks before. We should gate demo signups to collect org size & primary use-case.

Mika (Marketing): Routing: proposal is Intercom + HubSpot mapping: demo signups -> HubSpot new lead + tag "oss-refapp-demo"; high-usage trial accounts -> handoff to AE. Thoughts?

Jon (DevRel): Fine. For OSS repo issue templates, add short form to capture "company size" and "use case". I'll open PR after content is finalized.

Ara (Content): For messaging, let's avoid 'best-in-class' phrasing. Focus on reproducible benchmarks, low-latency for edge cases, and 'drop-in reference app' that shows routing + caching examples.

Mika (Marketing): Agreed. Also building a short one-page cheat sheet for devs: how to run locally, quantize, and point to our hosted example.

Kevin (Data): For routing rules (in HubSpot) suggest score-based assignment: demo_lead + company_size>50 => AE; otherwise to SDR. I'll share JSON mapping and a small webhook snippet: 

```json
{
  "event": "demo_signup",
  "fields": {
    "company_size": "<int>",
    "use_case": "<string>",
    "utm_campaign": "oss-refapp-launch"
  }
}
```

Mika (Marketing): Perfect. Can someone add UTM to all promo links? utm_medium=webinar|blog|github and utm_campaign=oss-refapp-2026.

Sam (PM): I'll add a short section in the roadmap doc about post-launch metrics to watch: demo signups, repo stars, tutorial completion, webinar attendance, conversion to dedicated trials.

Jon (DevRel): Quick ask — for the webinar demo, need a small dataset and a one-liner to reproduce our batching example. Will add to repo under examples/demo-data.

Ara (Content): Draft schedule: blog goes live Apr 20, tutorial drops Apr 22, webinar Apr 28. Promo cadence: announcement, short how-to clip, reminder 3 days, final reminder day-of.

Mika (Marketing): I'll draft the promo calendar and Slack snippets for internal share. Will also build an inbound playbook for SDRs with sample email templates and lead scoring.

Kevin (Data): One more: let's flag any lead from gov/reg sectors for security review -> route to enterprise AE.

Jon (DevRel): I'll open the repo PR tonight with the demo, issue templates, and a CONTRIBUTING.md tailored to the refapp.

calendar-bot: Event created: "OSS Reference App Webinar" Apr 28 15:00 UTC — guests: @Jon @Ara @Mika @Sam

Mika (Marketing): Action items summary: Ara = blog + benchmark draft (due Tue); Jon = tutorials + demo PR; Kevin = benchmark data + routing JSON; Sam = metrics + signup form fields; Mika = promo calendar + inbound playbook. Check-in Thu for copy review. :rocket:
